what: Gate 3.1: is CPU light selection worth optimizing? Measured before changing it.
scene: levels/bench_stress, scripted orbit, 400 frames, 1280x720, validation off
verdict: Light selection costs 0.068 ms p50 on the discrete GPU and 0.089 ms on the integrated one, against frames of 6.7 ms and 13.4 ms. It is not a bottleneck, so the scoring and sorting path is left alone. This is the measurement the plan required before touching it.
open: The per-fragment light loop is a separate question and is not answered here: this scene shows 25 lights at the scripted camera, not the 64 the audit stressed, and it is nearly empty of fill. Deciding on per-tile light lists needs the fill-heavy bench (Gate 3.2), which does not exist yet, plus the owner's low-tier budget number.
observation: The integrated GPU takes 2.0x the frame time of the discrete one on a scene of 8 draws and 108 triangles, so the fixed per-frame cost there is already material before any production content exists.
